title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
abstract: A machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the general n-dimensional combinatorial Sperner parity theorem on abstract n-dimensional pseudomanifolds with boundary for arbitrary dimension n : ℕ. Proves the local door-counting parity invariant on (n+1)-simplices, the global double-counting identity on door-facet incidences, and the master parity congruence modulo 2 relating panchromatic (n+1)-simplices to boundary doors. The theorem is conditional on an odd number of boundary (n-1)-doors; obtaining the classical geometric Sperner lemma for simplicial subdivisions of geometric simplices with boundary-preserving colorings is a specialization requiring an additional geometric boundary induction argument not contained in these abstract combinatorial declarations. This n-dimensional development (SpernerND.lean) generalizes and supersedes the fixed-dimensional combinatorial parity identities in the repository's lower-dimensional modules (SpernersLemma.lean and Sperner3D.lean) into a single unified parameterized architecture. To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration name, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).
